Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Vibrant Medallion Rug, 5' x 8', Pink
Colors: Ivory
Materials: Polypropylene
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported The vibrant colors and medallion design of this rug are sure to add an exciting pop of style to any room. Its beautiful hues of deep rouge outlined in blue make it the perfect addition to neutral décor. Distressed floral design Bright pattern with blue border Low, 0.2" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for fibers to settle
